$comment: Lines a change to each feature must read: backend module + docs + front files + the shared front modules (src/hooks, src/state, src/utils) those files import directly. Tests are excluded on purpose, so adding one never costs budget. A budget is a ceiling: `npm run check:context` fails when a feature grows past it, and a feature may sit up to ALLOWED_SLACK lines under it so that writing down why code exists is not paid for by deleting it. A reduction wider than that slack must be locked in with `npm run sync:context`, which also preserves a ceiling deliberately raised for headroom. Lower a budget by splitting a feature, or by shrinking a shared front module — one used by six features is charged to all six.
